name: Pomodoki
tagline: A Chrome extension that combines Pomodoro technique with Tamagotchi-style gamification to help you stay focused and productive.
description: Pomodoki is a Chrome extension (also available as iOS/Android app) that turns the Pomodoro focus technique into a creature-raising game. Users adopt a virtual pet ('Pomodoki'), set focus timers, and earn on-chain reward coins for completing sessions. The pet evolves as the user maintains streaks and consistency. The platform integrates with Slack (auto-DND, focus mode), has Telegram/Twitter integrations coming, and includes a 'Deep Research Learning' feature with AI-generated quiz questions. Built with on-chain records for virtual items and rewards on an unspecified blockchain (gas covered by Pomodoki).
techStack: Blockchain (on-chain records for virtual items/rewards — chain unspecified)
GPT Engineer (cdn.gpteng.co script detected — built with AI-assisted dev tool)

features: Tamagotchi-style virtual pet that evolves with focus consistency
On-chain reward coins earned per focus session
Slack integration: auto-DND + focus mode + /focus command
Deep Research Learning: paste research doc, read during timer, get AI quiz questions
Pomodoki Club (premium tier — early access, exclusive battles, feedback access)
userFlow: Install Chrome extension from Web Store (or download mobile app) → Create account and pick a Pomodoki character → Set focus timer → Work during session → Timer completes → Earn reward coins → Pet levels up → Unlock achievements and engage in community battles via Pomodoki Club.
valueProposition: Makes the scientifically-validated Pomodoro technique emotionally engaging by adding a virtual creature that grows with your consistency. Turns abstract productivity discipline into a tangible, gamified relationship — 'Built for Focus. Backed by Science. Loved by ADHD Minds.'
businessModel: Freemium: free Chrome extension with core Pomodoro timer + basic pet. 'Pomodoki Club' premium tier for early access to features, exclusive character battles, and feedback channel. Mobile apps (iOS + Android) as additional distribution. On-chain reward system creates potential future token/NFT economy. Built by POMODOKI LTDA (Brazilian company, CNPJ: 43.963.813/0001-90).

lessonsForPCC: Pomodoki's core insight is that gamification creates retention for habits that are inherently repetitive (focus sessions = physical task executions for PCC). The character personality system is directly applicable: PCC operator agents could have 'styles' or personas that users/clients relate to. Their approach of hiding gas costs from users (covering it themselves) is exactly the right UX pattern for PCC's on-chain verification — users shouldn't see gas mechanics, just seamless outcomes. The Slack /focus command integration pattern (one command = full workflow trigger) maps to PCC's potential Slack/Discord bot for job dispatch. Their 'Deep Research Learning' feature shows willingness to extend the core product into adjacent value (focus → learning) — PCC could similarly extend from task execution into analytics dashboards.
